job_hypothesis: Finish a home task without depending on anyone
name: Marcus Reed
behaviors: Lost most of his sight to glaucoma at 38
Hangs shelves and fixes things around the house using a beeping phone level app and touch
Asks his neighbor to check his work afterward and dislikes doing it
current_alternatives: A beeping phone level app used with VoiceOver
Asking his neighbor to check the work afterward
Tactile checks: running a hand along an edge, measuring down from the ceiling with a tape
Putting the job off until someone can help
objections: The free phone app is good enough most of the time
He'd need proof it's accurate before he stops asking for a second check
Plenty of products marketed as accessible were clearly never tested with blind users, so he's skeptical of the claim
A tone is hard to hear over a drill or with the TV on
recent_tasks: Mounted floating shelves in his home office about two weeks ago
Rehung a kitchen cabinet door that had started to sag, last month
Put up a new towel bar after the old one pulled out of the bathroom wall, last weekend
